title: Resource Status Schema
description: Two-axis status for any tracked resource (human, robot, agent, equipment, material, inspection): availability (is it reachable and allocatable for new work) and activity (what it is doing now), the same two-axis pattern voxel-group uses for rolledUpStatus (work progress) and rolledUpHealth (risk). A single-value status, as earlier resource messages carry it, maps as AVAILABLE -> (AVAILABLE, IDLE), ASSIGNED -> (ASSIGNED, IDLE), WORKING -> (ASSIGNED, WORKING), BREAK -> (AVAILABLE, BREAK), OFFLINE -> (OFFLINE, IDLE).

availability.description: Availability axis: is this resource currently reachable and allocatable for new work.

activity.description: Activity axis: what the resource is doing right now, independent of its availability. A resource on a scheduled break is AVAILABLE with activity BREAK.

$schema.description: Schema declaration: the URI of the schema this instance follows.
